set -eu
script=/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay
backup=/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay.before-repair

cat > "$script" <<'REPLAY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if [ ! -s "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    source_name=${message##*/}
    message_id=$(awk '
        { sub(/\r$/, "") }
        /^[[:space:]]*$/ { exit }
        tolower($0) ~ /^message-id[[:space:]]*:/ {
            line=$0
            sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
            sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", line)
            print line
            exit
        }
    ' "$message")

    if [ -z "$message_id" ]; then
        quarantine_file=$quarantine/$source_name
        if [ -e "$quarantine_file" ] && ! cmp -s "$message" "$quarantine_file"; then
            number=1
            while [ -e "$quarantine/$number-$source_name" ]; do
                number=$((number + 1))
            done
            quarantine_file=$quarantine/$number-$source_name
        fi
        if [ ! -e "$quarantine_file" ]; then
            temporary=$quarantine/.replay-quarantine-$$
            cp -p "$message" "$temporary"
            mv "$temporary" "$quarantine_file"
        fi
        printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: no Message-ID header was found before the end of the header block.' > "$quarantine_file.reason"
        printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$source_name" "${quarantine_file##*/}"
        continue
    fi

    if awk -v id="$message_id" 'NR > 1 && $1 == id { found=1 } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$index"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "$source_name" "$message_id"
        continue
    fi

    delivered_name=$source_name
    delivered_file=$delivered/$delivered_name
    if [ -e "$delivered_file" ] && ! cmp -s "$message" "$delivered_file"; then
        number=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/recovered-$number-$source_name" ]; do
            number=$((number + 1))
        done
        delivered_name=recovered-$number-$source_name
        delivered_file=$delivered/$delivered_name
    fi
    if [ ! -e "$delivered_file" ]; then
        temporary=$delivered/.replay-delivery-$$
        cp -p "$message" "$temporary"
        mv "$temporary" "$delivered_file"
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$delivered_name" >> "$index"
    printf 'delivered\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$source_name" "$message_id" "$delivered_name"
done
REPLAY_EOF
chmod 0755 "$script"
sh -n "$script"
printf '%s\n' 'syntax=ok'
ls -l "$script" "$backup"
